journey.name: update spending balance payment
journey.description:
Verifies that a Lightning payment that fits neither the LDK channel nor Spark alone, but fits both combined, runs as one payment: the confirm screen shows "Update fee" (testTag "ReviewUpdateFee") next to the payment's own fee, and one swipe first moves the channel's balance to Spark, then pays the invoice from Spark. The move shows in Activity as a "Move to Spark" row, and the emptied channel closes in the background. If the payment fails after the move, the funds stay in Spark and the usual payment error shows. QuickPay never sends such a payment; it always opens the confirm screen.
Precondition: dev build pointed at a local Spark regtest (spark-sdk regtest/local), QuickPay off, a wallet with an open channel to that stack's SSP Lightning node that can send about 30 000 sats and a Spark balance of about 30 000 sats, and a second wallet (or the stack's Lightning node) that can issue a 50 000-sat invoice. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: On the receiving side, create a 50 000-sat Lightning invoice and open it on the sending wallet with a lightning: deep link
Verify the Confirm screen (testTag "SendConfirm") shows 50 000 sats, then tap Show Details (testTag "SendConfirmToggleDetails")
Verify the fee row shows the payment's own fee and the "Update fee" row (testTag "ReviewUpdateFee") shows an amount, without "up to", and that no "Route" row shows
Swipe to pay (testTag "GRAB") and verify the Bitcoin Sent screen (testTag "SendSuccess") shows 50 000
Go back to Home and verify Activity lists a "Move to Spark" transfer row and the 50 000-sat Lightning payment
Open Settings › Advanced › Lightning Connections and verify the channel is closing or closed
